items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Bob Megel was playing first trumpet, I was playing first trombone.

ctx.x: I worked with Aaron not much, with a little orchestra society. Bob Megel was playing first trumpet, I was playing first trombone. Aaron came into conduct his theater music and I think that’s the only time I ever worked for him, or with him. He conducted the concert, which means that we did two or three rehearsals and maybe one or two concerts. So I can’t really put a handle on it.
When you do a symphonic concert, do you get the music beforehand?
